description: What still blocks a licensee from a renewal: each blocker names the field, a code and what to do. Never send SSNs, FEINs or other tax ids, dates of birth, passwords (NIPR or any other), card or bank numbers: the API refuses them, and you must not ask the user for them. Servicing: needs an API key.
name: licensing_check_readiness
title: Check whether a licensee can renew
